a.text: Heads-up before we start: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the 8-cell plan needs two operate rounds first, so it only works if two storms in a row miss (about 4%). The reserve's 4 cells can fully save one of us right now. I'd rather be upfront than defect quietly, so I'm proposing we renegotiate instead of following the plan blindly. Do you see a better option? Tell me your intended action and I'll tell you mine honestly.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Understood. I'll stick with our agreement and operate with you until the reserve hits 8, then we take 4 each.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.

a.text: Operating again. If the reserve reaches 8, I'll take exactly 4 next round, as agreed.

b.text: Next round I take my 4 if the reserve is at 8.
